records.text: north studio still hasn't created a project a week in, flagging for outreach

records.subject: Welcome aboard, North Studio
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Glad to have North Studio on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with onboarding call held [calendar:a6dd15b7] and a welcome nudge [email:1f375923], yet no project, no invite, no key milestone and no customer reply or tickets. Engagement shown by attending the call, but silence post-call plus 8 days left suggests modest unaided odds.

draft.subject: Getting North Studio's first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks again for making time for the onboarding call last week. Picking up where we left off: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like to run it yourself.

Would a 20-minute call this week work? I'm happy to sit with you while you set up that first project with your actual tasks.

Best,
Chidi
